title: REQ · Scene suite proves layer ordering, content-to-entity creation and visibility via @game
summary: A suite imports layers, buildScene and SceneObject through @game and asserts ordering, one entity per content object and visibility conditions.
description: Context: layers.ts, buildScene.ts and SceneObject.ts exist; buildScene sorts SceneObject by depth and sync() applies visibleWhen via evaluateAll. Desired behavior: one suite asserts these through @game with a fake RenderContext. Expected result: suite passes. Why: confirms SG-5.6.2 areas 1-3.
acceptance_criteria: Given objects authored in furniture, background, objects order, when buildScene runs, then depths come back ascending background, furniture, objects
Given a scene with N objects, when buildScene runs, then createSprite is called N times with each spec's asset, position and scale
Given an object with visibleWhen flag, when sync runs with the flag false then true, then setVisible receives false then true

preserve: existing buildScene, sceneObject and layers tests
